topics.title: Teaching of Qur’an on Obedience to Allah Primary 3 (Basic 3) - Islamic Religious Studies
topics.content:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS STUDIES
RELIGION AND NATIONAL VALUES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 2
PRIMARY 3
THEME -  IMPORTANCE OF HUMAN RELATION AND MUTUAL COOPERATION IN ISLAM
PREVIOUS LESSON -
TOPIC - TEACHING OF QURAN ON OBEDIENCE
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Meaning of Obedience
3. Reasons for Obedience
4. Memorize of Quran 4 :59
Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. explain the reasons why they should cooperate with people such as parents, brothers and others.
2. identify the people they should be obedient to.
3. point out an act of kindness and modesty.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of Holy Qur’an and Information technology device. .
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
The Holy Qur’an has commands everyone to obedience to Allah, his Messenger, parents, relatives and those in authority.
People demonstrate obedience by following the what the law has says. Children show obedience when they obey their parents and teachers. Obedience is respectful.
MEANING OF OBEDIENCE
Obedience is the behaviour that generally acceptable according to laws.
REASONS FOR OBEDIENCE AND THE WAYS IT CAN BE SHOWN
In Qur’an 17:23, Teaching of Qur’an on Obedience to Allah Primary 3 (Basic 3) - Islamic Religious StudiesAllah has commanded us to be obedience.
1. Do not worship any but Him.
2. Be good to your parents.
3. Show kindness to your parents, elders, fellow children, neighbours and other creatures.
4.  Speak to your parents with respect.
4. Modesty
LESSON 2 - THE OBEDIENCE VERSE - HOLY QUR’AN 4:59
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا اللهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّ‌سُولَ وَأُولِي الْأَمْرِ‌ مِنكُمْ ۖ فَإِن تَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي شَيْءٍ فَرُ‌دُّوهُ إِلَى اللهِ
وَالرَّ‌سُولِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ‌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ‌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا
TRANSLATION
O ye who believe! Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger, and those charged with authority among you. If ye differ in anything among yourselves, refer it to Allah and His Messenger, if ye do believe in Allah and the Last Day:
That is best, and most suitable for final determination.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Explains the importance of Human Relation.
Pupil’s Activities - Listen to the teacher’s explanation.
Narrates examples of punctuality, modesty and obedience.
Discusses the way through whuch obedience can be shown to them i.e. love them, greet them in the morning, do things that will make them happy.
Pupil’s Activities - Mention why they should be obedient to their parents, teachers, elders and leaders.
- Demonstrate acts of kindness in a play.
- Demonstrate act of modesty in role play.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to:
1. explain the ways in which they can obey their parents.
2. explain reasons why they should obey their parents.
3. identify the people they should be obedient to.
4. point out an act of kindness and modesty.

topics.title: Introduction to Tanwin Primary 3 (Basic 3) - Islamic Religious Studies
topics.content:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS STUDIES
RELIGION AND NATIONAL VALUES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 1
PRIMARY 2
THEME - ARABIC TEXT
PREVIOUS LESSON - Arabic Text of Suratul - Kauthar Primary 3 (Basic 3) - Islamic Religious Studies
TOPIC - INTRODUCTION TO TANWIN
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Meaning and Pronunciation of Tanwin with different vowels.
3. Copy letters with Tanwin
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. pronounce Tanwin with different vowels.
2. copy letters with Tanwin.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of Chart containing different alphabets with vowel sounds.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 -
Tanwin is the nunation of the Arabic short vowels.
Tanwin is the double Arabic short Arabic. ‎
تَنوِين‎
The Tanwin is an “n” sound added to the end of the word indicating an indefinite noun.
LESSON 2 - TYPES OF TANWIN
There are three types of tanwin:
1. Fatha Tanwin
Fathatan sounds ‘an’
2. Kasra Tanwin
Kasratan sounds ‘in’
3. Dhamma Tanwin
Dhammatan sounds ‘un’
ـَــًـ:
Fathatan
ـُــٌـ:
Dammatan
ـِــٍـ:
Kasratan
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays chart showing Tanwin.
3. Points and pronounces the Tanwin.
Pupil’s Activities - Listen to the pronunciation of the Tanwin.
4. Guides the pupils to pronounce the Tanwin many times.
Pupil’s Activities - Repeat the pronunciation many times.
5. Explains Tanwin as in the content.
Pupil’s Activities - Listen to the teacher’s explanation and explain.
6. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as instructed.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to:
1. pronounce Tanwin with different vowels.
2. copy letters with Tanwin.

topics.title: Arabic Text of Suratul - Kauthar Primary 3 (Basic 3) - Islamic Religious Studies
topics.content:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS STUDIES
RELIGION AND NATIONAL VALUES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 2
PRIMARY 2
THEME - ARABIC TEXT
PREVIOUS LESSON - Introduction to Tanwin Primary 3 (Basic 3) - Islamic Religious Studies
TOPIC - ARABIC VOWELS
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Recitation of Surah
3. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. recite the Surah correctly.
2. mention the difficult words and repeat their pronunciation correctly.
3. commit the Surah to memory.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of Chart containing different alphabets with vowel sounds.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - ARABIC TEXT OF SURATUL - KAUTHAR
إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ
فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ
إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ
LESSON 2 - REPEAT THE LESSON 1
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Writes the Arabic text of the Surah on the cardboard and fix it on the board.
3. Recites the Surah slowly.
Pupil’s Activities - Listen attentively to the teacher’s recitation.
- Repeat the Surah after the teacher.
- Recite the Surah in group and individually.
4. Listens to pupils’ recitation and identifies the mispronounced words.
5. Repeats the mispronounced words many times.
Pupil’s Activities - Repeat the mispronounced words after the teacher.
- Recite the Surah off head.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to:
1. recite the Surah correctly.
2. mention the difficult words and repeat their pronunciation correctly.
3. commit the Surah to memory.
